translation.title: Salicylic Acid Acne Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the treatment of acne.
translation.usage: Apply it twice a day, in the morning and in the evening.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have diabetes or a blood circulation disorder. Do not apply it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, or on areas with infection, inflammation, redness or irritation. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness or itching) from medicines or cosmetics, if you have kidney failure, festering (purulent) dermatitis, weeping (oozing) skin or erosion (raw skin), or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Follow the directed dose and schedule exactly. For children, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Take care that it does not touch skin other than the affected area. Take care that it does not touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse completely with plenty of water. Adverse reactions such as rash, redness, erythema (red patches), itching, or a local irritation reaction where the medicine touches healthy skin may occur; if they do, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
